name: MCC Network
description:
Welcome to MCC Network 

We are a friendly, feature-rich Minecraft Bedrock server network established in 2016 offering gamemodes such as Freebuild/Creative, SMP, Anarchy and more! 

Below is a short description of some of our modes: 

 Creative - Infinite, limitless worlds with full creative mode access for you to let your creativity take over! Explore the many legendary cities, build your very own, or just a small house! The choice is entirely yours! (Warning: Do not look at D_Y_Vinz's cities unless you want to feel immediately talentless and extremely jealous XD)

 SMP - Featuring two SMP servers: 

- A long-running public survival server active since 2020. 

- A Private SMP. whitelisted vanilla server accessible only through invitation via the Discord server. Season resets once a year. (https://discord.gg/dB2ZJVp)

 Anarchy - A legendary, lawless survival world over 8 years old! featuring a massive, chaotic history of player creation and destruction.

 Minigames - Take part in fun, challenging games such as SkyWars, TurfWars, Draw My Thing, Competitive Parkour, Dropper and more. 

 Legacy MCC - A snapshot of our legacy server from 2016-2022 Featuring many of our OG gamemodes such as SkyBlock, Prison, Factions, mini games and so much more! 

Join today for endless fun! You will not regret it! 

 Useful Links: 

Discord: https://discord.gg/dB2ZJVp
